Book Launch · Hyderabad · 2025

QUOTE CAFÉ

THOUGHTS IN A CUP

A soulful gathering of literary enthusiasts, artists, and readers coming together to celebrate the launch of Monika Chugh's latest book. Held in Hyderabad, Quote Café transformed into an intimate sanctuary of words, shared tea, heartfelt discussions, and artistic reflections.

"Words are cups that carry the spirit of our shared experiences, inviting every heart to take a sip."

— Monika Chugh
